does_not_cover: No p-value is ever computed or interpreted; title promises hypothesis testing but the video stops before any decision rule
No test statistic, z/t distribution, or critical value is constructed; rejection stays purely verbal
No Type I / Type II errors and no power concept appear anywhere in the transcript
No confidence interval and no duality argument is shown despite the L10 setting
notes: Gentle conceptual on-ramp; expects no prerequisites. Notation is drug A/B/C/D toy means, no formal H0/H1 symbols. Thin on inference machinery — pair with a video that actually computes a test.

segments.topic: Drug A vs B toy trial shows recovery times vary for random reasons
Rejecting a made-up 15-hour hypothesis after repeated opposite results
Failing to reject a 13-hour hypothesis when replicates differ only slightly
Why testing exact nonzero effects is hopeless and the null means zero difference
Small vs large samples decide whether the null can be rejected
